cases.question: Are employees required to use unique user accounts?
cases.claim: Yes, all employees are required to use unique user accounts.

evidence.text: CloudDesk Access Control Policy All employees must use unique user accounts. Multi-factor authentication is required for administrative access.
evidence.annotation_rationale: The policy explicitly states the claim.

evidence.text: Access Review CloudDesk reviews user access permissions every quarter. Terminated employee access is revoked within 24 hours.
evidence.annotation_rationale: This page neither establishes nor denies the claim; shared organization or access vocabulary alone is insufficient.
